name: edge
description: EDGEchat: Cyberpunk 2077 modding with the EDGE tools: modding knowledge as skills, the REDnode, REDcode, EDGEdeck and EDGEmat MCP servers, and modding commands.

rednode_token.title: REDnode MCP token
rednode_token.description: In the game, open the REDnode launcher: press F10 for REDnode's overlay, then click the REDNODE tab at the bottom left. Switch MCP server on and press Copy setup. Do not run the copied command; paste only the token, the text after 'Bearer '.

game_path.title: Cyberpunk 2077 folder
game_path.description: The game's install folder (it holds archive, bin and r6). Leave empty if REDcode is set up in VS Code: redcode-mcp then reads REDcode's setting.

redbridge_exe.title: REDbridge.exe
redbridge_exe.description: REDbridge, which reads the game's files. Leave empty if REDcode is set up in VS Code: redcode-mcp then reads REDcode's setting.

edgedeck_library.title: EDGEdeck library
edgedeck_library.description: EDGEdeck's mod library folder. Leave empty for the default, the EDGEdeck folder in your user folder. Set it only if you changed EDGEdeck's Library Path setting in VS Code.

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: For EDGEmat's materials from words (mat_generate), billed to your Google account. From aistudio.google.com > Get API key. Leave empty if you do not make materials from words, or use OpenAI.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: The other service for EDGEmat's materials from words, billed to your OpenAI account. From platform.openai.com > API keys. If both keys are set, Gemini is used unless you ask for OpenAI.
